description: Sarah Ho and Uwe Ehret at Karlsruhe Institute of Technology publish MATLAB code, input data and documentation for assessing irrigation reuse of small flood reservoirs. The June 2025 deposit contains FieldingFloods.zip and describes a tutorial for setting up a new model. Application inputs cover Baden-Württemberg, including weather products, crop and soil maps, reservoir parameters and inflows. A California Central Valley crop map is included only for tutorial use. MATLAB 2023a or newer with Mapping Toolbox is required; parts of the tutorial also use ArcMap or QGIS. The archive is free under CC BY 4.0, while commercial software licensing is separate. The model can compare reservoir reuse options in water-supply and adaptation simulations. Exact run periods, spatial resolutions and evaluation metrics remain unknown from the inspected metadata. A separate forecast-operation variant is linked from Zenodo 17571096; this earlier assessment is retained as a distinct model. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this resource.
